detail.longDescription: Hurkle-Durkling: The Science of a Slow, Guilt-Free Morning Hurkle-Durkling is the old Scottish word for lounging in bed after waking — and there's real neuroscience behind why it works. Here's how. https:// virtuousimprovement.wordpress. com/2025/02/17/hurkle-durkling-the-morning-routine-hack-that-boosts-your-day-with-zero-effort/
